scope.removed: Common OfflineService, OfflinePack, OfflinePackOptions, OfflinePackStatus, MapServices.offline, shared offline-service implementation and native backend normalization/conversions. Only tests exclusive to the retired normalized manager were removed.
scope.retained: Raw selected WrapperOfflineManager and other SDK facilities, all patches/peers/locks/support/version/candidate boundaries, location and independent snapshot services, snapshot input/output validation and four mocked native snapshot cases.
scope.application: Selected backend application commands directly call installed SDK managers. A pure read-only index preserves every enumerated native operation key, old oneMapReactOffline version1 application ID/user data, backend:<native-id> aliases, new regionId metadata, and malformed/ambiguous records. Lookup rejects ambiguous or malformed matches rather than guessing. Discovery does not write, rename, delete, reset or redownload.
scope.creation: RNMapbox names and NE/SW bounds remain distinct from generated MapLibre IDs and flat bounds. Failed creation preserves already-persisted packs. MapLibre can discover the generated key after post-persistence observer setup failure. SDK storage failures remain errors rather than empty lists.
scope.observerPolicy: Each example backend permits one owned SDK observer. A module-local ownership token stays reserved until pending creation or observer attachment settles, including after screen disposal. Replacement create/subscribe requests reject while the slot is active or pending; the caller may explicitly retry later. Cleanup checks its own token/key; stale callbacks and disposal cannot clear a replacement. No fanout, ordering queue, automatic retry or normalized service is recreated.
scope.screenAndHarness: Effect setup creates a fresh command owner and cleanup disposes it, including StrictMode replay. Shared scene no longer manages offline work. Native screen forwards explicit offline actions to the selected app commands. Harness uses decoded record.user for legacy application fields and explicit SDK subscription choices; actual pixel/cold-restart/storage observation intent remains.
scope.dataBoundary: Wrapper-level JSON parsing can reject enumeration before an application record exists; that failure is surfaced. The index preserves malformed records actually enumerated. It does not repair databases or establish runtime data preservation.

findings.classification: Introduced application observer replacement race found by independent U11 audit.
findings.trigger: Factory A starts asynchronous SDK setup, disposes, B attaches the same key, then A settles and unconditionally removes B callbacks. Creation callbacks/finalizers had the same pattern, including unknown generated IDs.
findings.fix: Per-backend application ownership token and pending barrier across factory instances. Late callback/cleanup paths check ownership; replacements wait by explicit rejection, without a queue.
findings.before: Prior implementer/reviewer observed six failing regression cases before the fix (eight existing command cases passed). Temporary red logs were cleared during interruption; the conversation retains that result.
findings.after: Fourteen command regressions plus one screen replay case and four metadata cases pass in fresh full suites; recovered code independently reviewed again. Resolve/reject setup on both SDKs, unknown-ID MapLibre creation, late callbacks and stale disposal are covered.

findings.classification: Pre-existing verification-tool retention defect exposed by disk exhaustion.
findings.trigger: Peer consumers accumulated until the outer finally; evidence write could fail first and bypass cleanup. A pre-interruption attempt left a generated 1.1GiB logical consumer directory; coordinator removed that exact owned directory.
findings.fix: Successful consumers are removed after assertions, hash/version capture, external lock copy and in-memory evidence. Outer output cleanup runs before report writing, so report failure cannot skip cleanup. Applied to both existing package runners, preserving all cases/assertions.
findings.verification: Syntax/formatting and read-only audit passed; fresh complete matrices pass with per-case cleanup. No live SDK operation was involved.
